knowledgeAnswers.rationale: SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), mesh section: a non-boundary mesh barrier must stay at 1200 mm or more under a 25 kg weight applied at any point on its top.
SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), mesh section: the base-gap check applies a 100 N vertical lift force to the base of the mesh or perforated barrier.
SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), mesh section: the gap at the base of a mesh or perforated barrier must stay within 100 mm under the 100 N lift.

practicalCriteria: Applies the 25 kg weight at any point on the top of a supplied mesh panel, and records the height against 1200 mm.
Checks the supplied footing layout against the SP 02 recommendation, and records the result and the decision in writing.
Applies a 100 N vertical lift to the base of a supplied mesh panel, and records the gap against 100 mm.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Load test record with equipment and height reading
Base-gap test record with the 100 N lift and gap reading
Assessor observation of the 25 kg load and the accept or reject decision
stopWorkCriteria: Mesh panel below 1200 mm under the 25 kg load: do not accept it; record the reading.
Test weight or 100 N equipment not recorded before use: do not test.
Base gap above 100 mm under the 100 N lift: do not accept the panel.
